map.计算单室Kt/V(spKt/V)和尿素下降率(URR)，评估血液透析充分性: Compute single-pool Kt/V (spKt/V) and urea reduction ratio (URR) to assess hemodialysis adequacy
map.核心计算公式（按输入变量）：-Math.log(R-0.008×tHours)+: Core calculation formula (by input variables): -Math.log(R-0.008×tHours)+(4-3.5×R)×ufL÷postWeight; spKt÷V - (0.6 × spKt÷V ÷ t) + 0.03; -ln(R - 0.008×t) + (4-3.5×R)×UF÷W
map.每周3次透析者，单次spKt/V目标≥1.2；每周2次者需更高单次Kt/V；短频: For patients dialyzed 3 times a week the single-session spKt/V target is ≥1.2; for 2 times a week a higher single-session Kt/V is needed; short daily dialysis (4-6 times per week) allows a lower single-session target.
map.提示：Kt/V是评估透析充分性的核心指标，受血流量、透析器面积、血管通路再循环、: Note: Kt/V is the core indicator of dialysis adequacy and is affected by blood flow, dialyzer surface area, vascular access recirculation and ultrafiltration volume. Post-dialysis BUN sampling should follow the slow-flow or stop-pump method to avoid the effect of recirculation. This tool is for learning reference only.
map.R=0.4、4h、UF 2L、透后 70kg：spKt/V≈1.07；3 次/周: R=0.4, 4h, UF 2L, post-dialysis 70 kg: spKt/V≈1.07; against the target of 1.2 for 3 sessions per week it is slightly insufficient, so increase the dose or extend the time.
map.spKt/V≥1.2(3 次/周)或 eKt/V≥1.2 为充分，过低提示剂量不: spKt/V≥1.2 (3 times per week) or eKt/V≥1.2 is considered adequate; a lower value indicates an insufficient dose.
map.spKt/V 单室、eKt/V equilibrated 校正再分布，后者更准: spKt/V is single-pool while eKt/V is equilibrated, correcting for rebound; the latter is more accurate.
map.3 次/周 1.2、2 次/周 1.8、1 次/周 3.0 为标准最低值。: Standard minimum targets are 1.2 for 3 sessions per week, 1.8 for 2 sessions and 3.0 for 1 session.
